blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30. The Sourcify exact-match LatamStable implementation 0x8898786f1e1e9ed77def940a2ecb7cf07af8d6ba (source re-opened 2026-07-30) inherits ERC20PausableUpgradeable with _update gated whenNotPaused, so a live PAUSER_ROLE can halt every holder transfer globally; it exposes no per-address blacklist, freeze, or seize mapping. All six deployments share this implementation: the Ethereum and Base proxy EIP-1967 implementation slots re-read at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608 both resolve to it, and the 2026-07-20 deployment-scoped transfer review verified code-hash identity on worldchain, bsc, polygon, and gnosis. Role history from RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs on Ethereum: deployer 0x5ca3f8eeba12d83408fc097c2dad79212456f20f held all roles from initialization (block 23891029) and was fully revoked at block 24995207, when DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, and UPGRADER all moved to Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b. Fixed-block reads confirm hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE, that EOA) = true and paused() = false at Ethereum block 25656501 and Base block 49328608; UPGRADER_ROLE (UUPS, no timelock) is held by the same EOA, with the 4-of-7 Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 as second DEFAULT_ADMIN. Reach is a token-level global pause controlled by a single EOA, not a per-address blacklist, and transfers are currently open; true reflects that live pause capability (same verdict basis as the dusd-dtrinity 2026-07-30 review). No wrapper or bridge inheritance applies - issuance is issuer-native burn-mint on every chain.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WCLP has six independent native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis; their native MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and UUPS upgrade paths remain in Mint Authority. The separate LimitedMinterBridge burn/mint adapter is issuer-operated bridge machinery and is route-scoped here with rate-limit, admin, pause, and bridge-mint capabilities. Celo is an authored deployment with a probable representation-like role graph, but its BridgeDeposit/operator binding remains unresolved.

controls.label: Ripio WCLP LimitedMinterBridge adapter
controls.capDescription: LimitedMinterBridge tokenConfigs returned a 76,000,000 wCLP dailyMaxMint on the Ethereum and Celo reads; its source exposes admin-controlled token registration and daily-limit changes, pause, and arbitrary-recipient minting.

routeChecks.caps: The adapter's tokenConfigs dailyMaxMint was 76,000,000 wCLP at the reviewed Ethereum and Celo reads; the source permits an administrator to change token registration and daily limits.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: BridgeDeposit.depositForBridge() burns source tokens and an operator fulfills destination minting, but the current BridgeDeposit address, operator binding, supported-token state, and route idempotency were not resolved.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: LimitedMinterBridge exposes admin-controlled token registration, pause, daily-limit changes, and arbitrary-recipient mintTo(). Its own MINTER_ROLE member count was zero on all seven current reads, so the active BridgeDeposit/operator and admin execution path remain an evidence gap.

controls.evidence: At the fixed 2026-08-16 reads, LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cB034FeC6ceC46CaeD4f61281f5Aa0Eb0e6 held WCLP MINTER_ROLE on the six authored native deployments and Celo. Its own MINTER_ROLE member count was zero on all seven current reads, so the live BridgeDeposit/operator is not established. The verified source nevertheless defines issuer-operated burn/mint, per-token daily limits, admin-controlled registration and limits, pause, and arbitrary-recipient minting; those capabilities remain route-scoped here and are not global native Mint Authority.
